title: Apply for a seasonal vehicle registration
summary: Apply for a seasonal vehicle registration if you only use your vehicle for part of the year.
intro:
If you only use your vehicle for part of the year, for example during the harvesting period or snow season, you can apply for a seasonal registration.

Seasonal registration lets you register a vehicle for a combination of unlimited 3-month or 6-month terms in a 12-month period.
who_can_apply: You must only use your vehicle for part of the year (e.g., during harvesting or snow season).
what_you_need: Proof of a previous registration, or proof of registration entitlement (such as a bill of sale receipt)
The appropriate inspection report (blue slip, pink slip, or brown slip depending on the vehicle type)
Compulsory third party (CTP) insurance (green slip) covering the period of seasonal registration

how_to_steps.text: Visit a Service NSW Centre and submit your application.

external_links.text: Seasonal vehicle registration – Transport for NSW
Vehicle registration fees, concessions and forms – Transport for NSW
Fees: Vehicle examiners, certifiers and assessors – Transport for NSW

faqs.a: Seasonal registration allows you to register a vehicle for a combination of unlimited 3-month or 6-month terms within a 12-month period.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to apply for seasonal registration?
faqs.a: You need your proof of identity, proof of a previous registration or entitlement (like a bill of sale receipt), the appropriate inspection report, compulsory third party (CTP) insurance (green slip) for the period, your registration fee payment, and the 'Application for Registration' PDF form.

faqs.q: Where do I submit my seasonal registration application?
faqs.a: You must visit a Service NSW Centre to submit your application.
